data.narrative:
Etched operates in the Chips & Semiconductors sector as a Series C company with a current post-money valuation of $5.0B and total capital raised of $10.3B. The comparable universe includes 11 private companies and 3 public peers (ALAB, NVDA, AMD), with relevant stage-matched private comparables including Tenstorrent ($2.7B Series D), d-Matrix ($2.0B Series C), Positron AI ($1.0B Series B), and DEEPX ($529M Series C).

Two valuation methodologies are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x multiplier to the last post-money valuation of $5.0B, implying $8.5B. Peer-median analysis across the four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $1.5B, with a range spanning $529M to $2.7B. The substantial divergence between methods reflects the considerable variance in how private semiconductor companies at similar stages have been valued, with peer multiples clustering significantly below Etched's current mark.

Triangulation of both methods supports a range of $1.3B (low) to $9.8B (high), with a median of $5.0B. The wide band reflects tension between stage-progression methodologies, which assume continuation of historical step-up patterns, and peer comparables, which suggest material compression from Etched's current valuation. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to peers and whether the semiconductor subsector commands valuation premiums beyond what the current peer set reflects.
